parameters.query:
SELECT
  e.id AS equipment_id,
  e.serial_number,
  e.model_number,
  e.equipment_type,
  m.id AS manufacturer_id,
  m.name AS manufacturer_name,
  m.incident_contact_email,
  m.incident_contact_name,
  m.phone AS manufacturer_phone,
  f.name AS facility_name,
  f.address AS facility_address
FROM zipsafe.equipment e
JOIN zipsafe.manufacturers m ON m.id = e.manufacturer_id
JOIN zipsafe.facilities f ON f.id = e.facility_id
WHERE e.id = {{ $json.equipment_id }}

parameters.subject: =[ZipSafe Incident Report] {{ $('Extract Incident Details').item.json.incident_type }} — Equipment {{ $('Lookup Equipment and Manufacturer').item.json.serial_number }}

INSERT INTO zipsafe.manufacturer_notifications (
  incident_id,
  manufacturer_id,
  equipment_id,
  recipient_email,
  recipient_name,
  delivery_status,
  sent_at
) VALUES (
  {{ $('Extract Incident Details').item.json.incident_id }},
  {{ $('Lookup Equipment and Manufacturer').item.json.manufacturer_id }},
  {{ $('Extract Incident Details').item.json.equipment_id }},
  '{{ $('Lookup Equipment and Manufacturer').item.json.incident_contact_email }}',
  '{{ $('Lookup Equipment and Manufacturer').item.json.incident_contact_name }}',

  NOW()
)
RETURNING id
